entities.summary: Jay Fletcher Vincent is an American former professional basketball player. He played college basketball for the Michigan State Spartans. Vincent was selected 24th overall by the Dallas Mavericks in the 1981 NBA draft, for whom he played five seasons, followed by four seasons with five other NBA teams. Vincent also played professionally in Italy.
